Plot source participant functional random-effects scientific artists

etr_plot_functional_random_effects.Rd

Frozen Python eyetrajectoriespy 1.2.0 source-scientific plot geometry, while preserving original native R scientific estimators and default base R return values.

Usage

etr_plot_functional_random_effects(result, effect = "intercept",
  max_participants = NULL, alpha = 0.35, strict_source_record = FALSE)

Arguments

result

Native realized participant mixed-model random-effect result, including source participant IDs and fitted random-intercept or random-slope functions.

effect

Source participant functional intercept or slope.

max_participants

Optional first number of participants. Strict source mode requires a positive R integer, matching Python's int requirement.

alpha

Matplotlib source opacity between zero and one inclusive.

strict_source_record

TRUE returns a typed native R Matplotlib scientific artist record, including per-participant source order, opacity, conditional legend and dashed zero line; default retains numeric source audit lines.

Value

Default invisible original source-ordered R numerical line geometry. Strict mode returns a typed native R scientific artist record with source axes, original fitted participant BLUP functions, legend only for at most 12 participants and zero reference. No Python Matplotlib Axes identity, estimator refit or complete Python object domain.

Details

Bounded native source-scientific artist parity only: no Python dataclass or pandas runtime protocol, injected Axes identity, pixel rendering equivalence, exception subclass identity, exact-head executable qualification or independent full-source contract certification.
